overall_summary: Husband-Wife relationship topics consistently outperform all other content pillars on the channel by over 5x-8x in views and engagement, while abstract shayari and general sibling videos underperform.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about married life ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar...' - 1,770 views, 'Patni Ki Ye Baat...' - 1,679 views) generated the highest views and likes on the channel.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on relatable, nuanced marriage micro-dramas and subtle relational friction.

winning_patterns.pattern: Relatable relationship conflicts with empathetic framing
winning_patterns.evidence: 'Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala...' gained 392 views compared to poetry/shayari videos.
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks on unsaid emotional compromises in daily routines.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'Jis Din Sach Likhoonga...' got only 21 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic poetic lines without concrete real-life situations.

weak_patterns.evidence: Sister videos scored between 19 and 140 views.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize generic appreciation shorts unless paired with a strong situational hook.
